emg.source: single sEMG channel, SeizeIT2 left deltoid placement

accelerometer.note: training data rescaled per run so that median |acc| = 1 g

gyroscope.unit: any fixed unit (only scale-invariant gyroscope features are used)

input.axes: any orientation: all features are rotation invariant
input.timestamp: ms of the last sample in the window; windows arrive every hop_s

quality.rule: a flat EMG or IMU window scores 0

postprocessing.rule: alarm when the mean of the last k scores >= threshold and no alarm in the previous refractory_s seconds; a gap in the stream restarts the mean

output.score: internal only, never shown to users
